map.为什么实际速度达不到标称？: Why doesn't actual speed reach the rated value?
map.三个常见原因：标称值是接口理论带宽（如 10 Gbps），扣除编码开销与协议损耗: Three common reasons: the rated value is the interface's theoretical bandwidth (e.g., 10 Gbps), and after encoding overhead and protocol loss the actual transfer is usually about 70%; the cable and dock don't support the corresponding speed; the device itself (e.g., a low-end USB stick) flash speed is the bottleneck. When buying, look at the device's measured speed, not the interface label.

map.实际速率取两端设备与线缆的较低者: Actual speed is the lower of both ends' devices and cable
